### What I'm Working Toward

I'm building toward a career in **financial data analytics and data science** — solving practical problems and communicating insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

### Life as a Student-Athlete

::: athlete-callout
🏈 Playing D-I football at Baylor means committing **20+ hours every week** to practice, film study, travel, and competition — on top of a full academic course load. That environment has sharpened my ability to manage time ruthlessly, perform under pressure, lead in a team setting, and show up consistently even when it's hard. I bring that same standard to my data work.
:::
